name: Equality World Cup
content: Problems and Purpose Equality World Cup (Span. Mundial de la Igualdad) was an overarching initiative that aimed to promote an agenda on issues of gender equality during the World Cup in Russia 2018. It consisted of different events and spaces which involved educational and informative aspects, social networks and sports meetings.Background History and ContextOrganizing, Supporting, and Funding EntitiesThe World Cup of Equality was a process coordinated and promoted by Datasketch (Colombia), Economía Feminista (Argentina) and Futbol Femenino (Peru).Participant Recruitment and SelectionMethods and Tools UsedWhat Went On: Process, Interaction, and ParticipationA hackathon was held in Buenos Aires and then replicated in Bogotá, Pasto and Lima, where data was collected and the information dissemination strategy was set up. Additionally, soccer tournaments were played with women's and LGBT+ teams. Later, a virtual World Cup was held parallel to the World Cup in Russia in 2018, through the hashtag #Equality World Cup, in which each country that played a match, also had to face issues of gender equality: sexual and reproductive rights, anti-discrimination laws, femicide figures, educational and salary gap, equal marriage, and legal abortion.Influence, Outcomes, and EffectsAnalysis and Lessons LearnedSee AlsoHackathonReferencesExternal Linkshttp://www.igualdata.org/ [DEAD LINK]Resumen del Mundial de la Igualdad¿De qué se trata el Mundial de la Igualdad?Notes
